format_notes: GoldenFloat phi-aligned radix-2 float S1E6M25, bias 364. IEEE-style specials at top exponent

catalog.standard: this work; e is 6 balanced-ternary TRITS not bits (9.51 bits equivalent); width rule 1+Et+M=N; post-route XC7A200T 1477 LUT 83.3 MHz, no DSP, 1 cycle
catalog.use_case: fixed-field ternary-exponent ladder; no regime codec

anchor_check.note: 3.0 is not an exact grid point of this format at this width

round_trip_policy: decode: exact bits->f64 (curated_named). encode (reference): round-nearest-ties-even; overflow per format convention. abs_error 0 for representable values.
